notes: The input-output-CD (33-character) form of 1985-SR-XIV.2.2.3-5, answered once there: an ODO record of maximum 33 is a fixed-length record of 33 (VI.5.8.4 GR2b, GR5), and an 88 in a later record is a VALUE clause the rule bans. The scaled-item count is right (s5p refuses X(26)+9(4)P(3) BINARY, 30 characters).

next.reason: 1985: "Record description entries following an input-output CD entry implicitly redefine the record area established by the input-output CD entry"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the CD entry; no candidate covers communication description entries or their record areas". No 2023 clause carries the communication description entry, and no candidate addresses records redefining a CD record area. The feature is absent from 2023.
